body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

**Testing project:** [test_probe_caching.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21197150/test_probe_caching.zip)

The cache is preserved across restarts, and it's also kept if you've only changed lights and didn't change any LightmapProbe nodes or the LightmapGI Gen Probes Subdiv property.

Bake times (with cache) before and after this PR on a Linux optimizzed editor (`production=yes lto=full`):

### `master`

First bake | Second bake
-|-
7s | 7s

### This PR

First bake | Second bake
-|-
6s | 1s

(The MRP uses very low texel density so that probe baking takes up most of the time.)

<details open>

<summary>PC specifications</summary>

- **CPU:** AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090
- **RAM:** 64 GB (2×32 GB DDR5-6000 CL30)
- **SSD:** Solidigm P44 Pro 2 TB
- **OS:** Linux (Fedora 42)
</details>
